old_value: {"id":"fedistract-xzkb.39","title":"fieldwork reqwest dep uses default features (native-tls)","description":"fieldwork/Cargo.toml line 41: reqwest = { version = \"0.12\", features = [\"json\"], optional = true } -- this does not set default-features = false, so it pulls in reqwest's default TLS backend (native-tls/OpenSSL). All three downstream servers (smallhold, gaja, broadside) explicitly use default-features = false with rustls-tls. Because Cargo unifies features additively, the final binary compiles both native-tls AND rustls-tls, adding unnecessary binary size and attack surface.
